retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring a dark silhouette centered against a massive, glowing yellow sun on a textured red field with bold stencil-style typography.
triggerTerms: red and yellow high contrast graphic
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central dark silhouette of a figure or landmark positioned against a large, circular yellow sun that occupies most of the frame. The background is a saturated, grainy red. Typography is white, bold, and features vertical stencil gaps, arranged in a top-heavy and bottom-left hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette centered within the circular sun
Sun glowing against a textured red background
Bold white stencil text framing the top and bottom-left
High contrast between dark foreground and bright yellow core

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central silhouette occupies the lower-middle vertical axis, scaled to fit within the sun's diameter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow sun acts as the primary visual anchor and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top headline, move down to the central silhouette, and finish at the bottom-left title block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The red background provides textured negative space around the sun and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast between the sun and the silhouette/background.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stencil gaps in the center of strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'B', 'O', and 'R' feature vertical breaks in their curved or straight vertical segments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary wide sans-serif for subtitles to contrast the condensed main display.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast image of a large yellow sun centered on a deep red textured background, with a dark silhouette of a figure in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, extra-condensed white stencil typography at the top and bottom-left, ensuring vertical gaps in the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the sun a distinct yellow circle?
Is the background a grainy red?
Does the text have vertical stencil gaps?
Is the silhouette solid and dark?

mustRedesign: Exact silhouette of the Statue of Liberty
postGenerationChecks: Check for three-color harmony (Red, Yellow, White)
Confirm grainy texture is consistent across the red field
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject] silhouette + [Large Yellow Sun] + [Grainy Red Background] + [White Condensed Stencil Type].
